description: Hourly and day rate a freelancer needs to take home a target income after tax, business costs, time off, non-billable hours and a slow-month buffer; optionally checks what a given rate pays per year. Defaults match the free web calculator ($60,000 take-home, $6,000 costs, 30% tax, 6 weeks off, 40 h/week, 65% billable, 10% buffer, 8 h day).

billable_pct.description: Share of hours you can bill % (default 65)

buffer_pct.description: Buffer for slow months and unpaid invoices % (default 10)

check_rate.description: Optional: an hourly rate to check what it pays you per year

day_hours.description: Billable hours in a full client day (default 8)

take_home.description: Income you want to take home per year after tax, USD (default 60000)

tax_rate_pct.description: Estimated tax rate on profit %, default 30 (use the estimate tool for a 2026 figure)

name: freelance_hourly_rate
title: Freelance hourly rate calculator
